question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget ship as a sessions.list-backed builtin through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should this issue wait for the broader sessions.activity Gateway contract first?
rationale: The current code can expose coarse active/idle state, but the requested task, progress, and attention semantics overlap a still-open Gateway API/product decision that automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat the linked PR as the candidate UI solution and require its review blockers, proof, and rebase/security work to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for sessions.activity
options.body: Keep this issue open until the broader Gateway activity contract lands, then implement the widget against that richer source of truth.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own sequencing after preserving this issue's unique status-widget details there.

recommendation.title: Keep staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat the linked PR as the candidate UI solution and require its review blockers, proof, and rebase/security work to clear before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history points to him on both the Control UI plugin-tab seam and the sessions status projection that this product choice crosses.
